# signal

Signal and image processing, scipy.signal and librosa style: windows, filter design and application, multirate processing, spectral and time-frequency analysis, wavelets, decompositions, detection, adaptive filters, peaks, similarity and matrix profiles, audio features and image processing. The filters, windows and wavelets folders are part of this entry point.

- structure `signal.ts` (file): Signal, Spectrum and TimeFrequency records shared across the domain. `src/lib/signal/signal.ts:1` `mdml-engine/signal`

- function `findPeaks`: Peaks of a signal with prominence and width filters. `src/lib/signal/peaks.ts:212` `mdml-engine/signal`
- function `resample`: Fourier resampling to a given number of samples. `src/lib/signal/multirate.ts:237` `mdml-engine/signal`
- function `stft`: Short-time Fourier transform; spectrogram sits beside it. `src/lib/signal/time-frequency.ts:164` `mdml-engine/signal`
- function `welch`: Welch power spectral density estimate. `src/lib/signal/spectral.ts:287` `mdml-engine/signal`

- algorithm `emdAlgorithm`: Empirical mode decomposition, one sifting step at a time. `src/lib/signal/decompositions.ts:280` `mdml-engine/signal`

## signal/filters

Digital filter design and application, scipy.signal style, part of `mdml-engine/signal`: FIR design by windows, frequency sampling and Parks-McClellan, IIR design from analog prototypes (Butterworth, Chebyshev, elliptic, Bessel) with minimum-order selection, filtering with transfer functions or second-order sections including zero-phase filtering, and frequency, group-delay and specification checks.

- function `butter`: Butterworth IIR filter design. `src/lib/signal/filters/iir.ts:184` `mdml-engine/signal`
- function `sosfilt`: Apply a filter in second-order sections; lfilter takes a transfer function. `src/lib/signal/filters/apply.ts:269` `mdml-engine/signal`

## signal/image

Image processing, scipy.ndimage and scikit-image style, available as `mdml-engine/signal/image`: N-dimensional correlation and filters, geometric transforms and pyramids, mathematical morphology, feature and edge detectors, motion estimation and optical flow, and thresholding, watershed and graph-based segmentation.

- function `canny`: Canny edge detector. `src/lib/signal/image/features.ts:400` `mdml-engine/signal/image`

## signal/wavelets

Wavelet transforms, matching pywt, part of `mdml-engine/signal`: the discrete wavelet families and continuous wavelets, the discrete, stationary and continuous wavelet transforms with their inverses in one and two dimensions, and wavelet-shrinkage denoising.

- function `cwt`: Continuous wavelet transform. `src/lib/signal/wavelets/cwt.ts:83` `mdml-engine/signal`
